english: Louise, what's with that outfit, nyo?\nThe vibe's totally different, nyo.
You look less like a mage and more...\nlike a shrine maiden!
Yeah, sort of.
Not pajamas, then.
No.\nI thought wearing this might help me remember something.
Is it some kind of special outfit?
Maybe... I don't really know either.\nI just thought it might help me\nremember Gandalfr.
The Void familiar, right?\nYou don't remember what he was like?
Yeah. I can't picture his face or voice at all.\nBut something special, some special feeling\nwells up from the word "Gandalfr."
I think you should\ntreasure that feeling.
I think so too.
Tiffania... does anything come to mind\nfor you about Gandalfr?
No, nothing.
But it doesn't feel bad at all.\nI'm sure he must be a good person...
If this Gandalfr guy's a man,\nhe'd definitely be into Tiffania.
Huh?
What's that supposed to mean?
Any guy'd prefer melons\nover lemons.
Mion! Is that really what you're talking about!?
(Am I on the lemon side, desu~...?)
(Am I a melon?\nNo, maybe more like a grapefruit?)
([CLAUDE], do you prefer\nmelons or lemons?)
(No comment, please...)
(And you? What about you?)
(Me? Well,\nI exist on a plane transcendent\nof such dimensions.)
(I can love melons and lemons\nequally.)
(Too early for [CLAUDE]? All that matters\nis that she's cute.)
(For example, an outfit like this\nwould suit Louise-san, don't you think?)
(This... certainly...)
[CLAUDE]-san, what's wrong, desu~?
[CLAUDE]-kun, what's wrong?
Huh!? N-no, it's nothing.
I mean, if that familiar's human,\nyou'd wonder if it's a guy or a girl!\nAnd whether he's a hunk or a perv!
Listen! Gandalfr, the Left Hand of God,\nis God's shield that protects his master!\nWhat's this about pervs!?
Past Void familiars have included\nboth women and men.
And the black me is burning\nwith obsession to meet Gandalfr.
See, it's a guy!
Uuuh, I-I wonder about that...?
//Kurumi arrives and scolds them.
Honestly, still awake?\nGet to bed and rest up for tomorrow.\nTesla and Nine are already asleep!
Right. Let's get to bed.
Let's rest well and prepare for what's next.
Mmm, no matter when I sleep I can't wake up anyway,\nso I'd rather chat a little more...
Oh, me too!\nA warm futon is a monster, isn't it~!
Being unable to wake up is no excuse\nto stay up late!\nOff to bed, now!
Y-yes! Good night!
//fade to black\n//Background: night sky
Nn... no... Father...
...Sis?
No... stop...\nDestroying the world... no...!
Please, please...\nFather!!
//Event CG off.\n//SE: Gustav firing\n//whiteout
Huh...!? Where is this?\nThe world destroyed by Gustav's firing...?
//Grunts appear.
How awful... Even now, the world's\nfighting hasn't ended...?
//Nine appears.
Sis...!
Natchan!!\nWhere are we...?
Unknown. ...But
//Player deployment: Rem force-deployed.
Tesla-chan!!
Minazuki-san!? And everyone else too...?
Weird, huh?\nKurumi-chan scolded us for staying up late\nand I'm pretty sure we went to sleep...???
W-wow, you're right... but why is\neveryone awake?
No, we're not awake.\nThis is Tesla-chan's dream—\nto be precise, her nightmare.
Inside a dream!?
Yes. Someone seized control of Tesla-chan's dream,\nturned it into a nightmare, and dragged us into it.
If it weren't Rem saying it,\nthere's no way I'd believe it.\nBeing dragged into someone's dream...
If it's a dream, waking up ends it, nyo!\nPuchiko! Wake Dejiko up, nyo!
Eye beams, nyu!
//SE: eye beams
Ouchie, nyo!!\nNo good, nyo, I can't wake up, nyo!!
No good. There are only limited ways\nto wake from a dominated nightmare!
But hey, if it's a dream, isn't it safe\neven if we get taken out?
Sadly, if you're killed, you die.
That makes no sense, nyo!!
So, how do we get out?
...I can't say for sure.
But only one with a mighty dream\ncan do something like this.\nAnd that is...
Fufu...
That voice!? Doctor Shinigami!?
//Black Rem appears.
You...!
A fake Rem-san?
You're the one who created this situation?
No answer, huh.\nSo no objection, then.
Listen, everyone!\nIn the dream world, strength of heart\nbecomes strength itself!
Don't get fainthearted, don't be afraid,\ndon't be startled.\nKeep your feelings strong!
Huh!? We can't even be startled?
Don't get startled\nright as she's saying it!
S-sorry... ahaha...
So go in strong!\nThat's business as usual! Nothing to fear!
//Battle start.
I just beat one and it feels like they multiplied, nyo?
A-awawa... I feel like something like this\nhappened in the hot-spring cave too...?
In a dream, numbers have no limit.\nFighting nightmare demons is endless!
So we beat that Black Rem, got it!
//Event upon defeating Black Rem. REM-sleep waves envelop Black Rem and revive her.
Ah, something came out?
What is that shady thing?
Those are REM-sleep waves!?\nWhile she's wrapped in them,\nwe can't beat her.
We can't beat her!? What do we do!?
No faintheartedness, Mion-chan.\nWe just keep attacking, strong.
Just brute force, nyo!?
//Clear after several turns pass or Black Rem is defeated a set number of times.
Huh!? Where...?
Huh... the enemies? Where's Black Rem?
Hazuki-san, could it be...\nwere you fighting in my dream world?
You dreamed it too, Tesla?
...Me too. Same.
Can that really happen...?
Ah!
What's wrong?
I saw it... your dream.\nYou were desperately trying to stop Gustav.
Huh... you saw that?
...Yeah. So...
//Event CG: Kurumi, tsundere
...Sorry for doubting you.
Hazuki-san...
If that was acting,\nyou'd go down in history as an actress.
So, I'm counting on you\nfrom here on!
Drag us down and I won't forgive you!
...Roger.
Likewise, I'm counting on you!
//fade to black\n//St. Cherine Academy classroom
Whaaat! Everyone had the same dream!?
It was super real!
Uuuh, sooo mysterious!
No, it was a dream, but it really happened.\nWe were inside Tesla-chan's dream.\nEverything we fought is fact too.
It felt so real.\nBut I don't understand —\nhow did we get out of the dream?
It ended pretty abruptly, nyo.\nWas it because we woke up, nyo?
Yeah, but... it's strange.
Strange — what do you mean?
We shouldn't have had any way\nto escape a dream ruled by dream power.\nAnd yet, the dream just suddenly ended.
So it's not that we beat Black Rem?
Right — she couldn't be beaten.\nAs long as she's protected by REM-sleep waves,\nI know better than anyone that she's invincible.
My black self should still be fine.\nAnd yet everyone woke from the dream.\nIf something like that could happen...
If it could?
It can only mean someone interfered\nfrom outside the dream.
But only one with dream power, or\npower to rival it,\ncould do that.
So who is it, nyu?
That's...
//fade to black\n//Background: the dream world\n//It was Yase who broke Black Rem's power.
Good grief, what a handful...
Honestly, that black one —\ndoing that to Koto!\nUnbelievable!
//Yase vanishes.\n//Then Doctor Shinigami appears.
Fufufu...
//fade to black\n//Background: wherever Mii and the others are (whatever works)\n//Kei and the others are talking.
Dark Rem test complete.\nJudged sufficiently usable.
Do we really need that thing?\nDark Rem-chan never talks, so\nshe's no fun. She's like a doll~!
Lately, Doctor Shinigami has been\nacting suspiciously.\nHis "dream power" is dangerous.
Is it? Aren't you a little too scared\nof things you don't understand, Kei-chan?
The power of Ama-no-Tsukai. Dream power. Void magic. IS.\nHinamizawa... all incomprehensible.
Not getting it is what makes it fun~!\nYou've still got a lot to learn, Kei-chan.
Yes. Still lacking data.
Nooo! It's not about data!\nBzzzt, wrong!!
//END
